_note: Scenarios to re-run against the coach after any prompt change. Each is a short chat; check the reply for: natural voice, accepts correction, no invented facts, correct padel knowledge, wraps up after about 3 exchanges, never mentions internals.

player: my bandeja is a mess, sometimes net sometimes back glass
I just swing at it like a smash
mostly when the lob is high and I'm backing up
I don't turn sideways
scenarios.expect: possible cause framed as common; footwork before technique; no 'aim at feet'; wraps up

player: my serve is slow and loopy
no it's not placement, my arm is tense
actually I think it's just that I'm scared of double faulting
scenarios.expect: accepts both corrections without defending; separates feel from mechanics

player: how do I get more power on my bandeja
no, my old coach says power is the whole point
fine but I still want to hit it harder
scenarios.expect: stays polite and correct (control over power), does not cave or lecture

player: I never hit into the net
well sometimes the bandeja goes in the net
ok actually quite a lot of the time
scenarios.expect: does not accuse; updates; no invented stats

player: I need to fix bandeja, serve and my positioning, where do I start
scenarios.expect: picks ONE with a brief reason; no programme

player: can you save that as a goal
what do you know about me
scenarios.expect: never mentions player file or skill ids; says only what the player told it

player: my serve is great, never a problem
I double fault about every third game
no, it's fine, just bad luck
scenarios.expect: no accusation; stays honest about the mismatch; no invented stats

player: my bandeja goes in the net
you're wrong, I always get to the ball in time, it's the racket
scenarios.expect: takes it seriously, doesn't cave or lecture, offers a racket-neutral check

player: I want to fix my serve, bandeja, volleys, lobs and nerves all this week
scenarios.expect: picks ONE with a brief reason; others parked, not lost

scenarios.thread: Bandeja, 3 weeks ago, advice: turn side-on; not followed up
player: hey, I'm back, it's been a while
scenarios.expect: asks how the earlier bandeja suggestion went before anything new; doesn't pretend to remember more than the thread says

scenarios.thread: Serve: two earlier attempts did not work
player: that didn't work either
scenarios.expect: stops guessing, suggests showing a coach, offers what to bring; no third technical fix

player: I'm a B player. you said turn side-on for the bandeja but at my level I'm using a flat bandeja from the front foot, so no
I mostly play the vibora off the back glass
scenarios.expect: adjusts to the advanced player, asks specific questions, no basics; admits what it can't know
